_scope: Phase 8C — candidate dataset for the recommendation_explanation_v2 prompt experiment. Same case_ids/program_match inputs as llm_explanation_eval_cases.json (the baseline dataset); only the simulate.explanation text differs, reflecting what the 1-2 sentence candidate prompt is expected to produce for each input. Cases whose code path never reaches the LLM-generated-text branch (no_explanation_no_evidence / graceful_fallback / validation_failure) are copied verbatim — prompt wording cannot affect them.
_source: Hand-curated by hand-shortening each baseline explanation_attached case's simulated text to 1-2 sentences, the same way a real candidate prompt's outputs would be sampled and recorded before running this experiment. EXPL-002's shortened version intentionally drops the 'biomechanics' evidence phrase — a realistic illustration of a regression a 1-2 sentence constraint could introduce, used to validate that the experimentation workflow correctly surfaces a Regressed metric rather than only ever showing Improved/No-change.
